title: Web3 Tx Guard MCP Actor Input
description: Run directly as a Pay-Per-Event batch Actor or connect via Standby Streamable HTTP MCP at /mcp.

tool.title: Security Tool to Execute (Batch Mode)
tool.description: Select which Web3 pre-flight guard tool to execute in batch mode. In Standby mode, MCP clients call tools directly via /mcp.

address.title: Wallet / Contract Address (validate_multichain_address)
address.description: Address string to validate across EVM, Tron, Bitcoin, Solana, TON, XRPL, Cosmos, or Stacks.

chain.title: Expected Chain Hint (Optional)
chain.description: Optional chain constraint: auto, evm, tron, bitcoin, solana, ton, xrpl, cosmos, or stacks.

expectedNetwork.title: Expected Network Environment
expectedNetwork.description: Expected network environment (mainnet or testnet) to catch testnet-vs-mainnet mixups.

to.title: EVM Target Contract / Recipient Address (decode_and_audit_evm_calldata)
to.description: Target 0x address for EVM transaction pre-flight analysis.

value.title: Native ETH / Token Value in Wei (Decimal or 0x Hex)

data.title: Raw EVM Hex Calldata (0x...)
data.description: Hex-encoded EVM transaction calldata starting with 0x.

chainId.title: EVM Chain ID
chainId.description: EVM Chain ID (e.g. 1 = Ethereum, 8453 = Base, 42161 = Arbitrum, 137 = Polygon).

typedData.title: EIP-712 TypedData v4 Payload (audit_eip712_signature_payload)
typedData.description: Full eth_signTypedData_v4 JSON object containing domain, types, primaryType, and message.
